preconditions.description: The number of points n must be between 3 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= x_i <= 10**9 and -10**9 <= y_i <= 10**9 for x_i, y_i in points)
preconditions.description: All coordinates of the points must be within the range of -10^9 to 10^9.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n - 2 and all(c in 'LR' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have a length of n-2 and consist only of characters 'L' and 'R'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not valid_permutation else True
postconditions.description: If no valid permutation exists, the output must be -1.

postconditions.expression: len(set(p)) == n and all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p)
postconditions.description: The output permutation must contain n unique integers from 1 to n.
The polygonal line formed by the permutation must be non-self-intersecting and winding according to the string s.
